content: Researchers uncover distinct zones and age-associated changes in a key brain area Studies reveal differences between people in the cellular makeup of the striatum and changes that occur during aging, paving the way to mapping the whole human brain. By Leah Eisenstadt November 12, 2026 Credit: Courtesy of researchers Haoyuan Gao, Natalie Navarro Suarez, and Kiku Ichihara. Oil pastel drawings made by Broad researchers depict details of the human striatum.
